name: Promarine Collagen Peptid
headline: Promarine Collagen — marine peptides
description: Marine collagen peptides as a daily drink — for skin, hair and joints. Part of your daily beauty ritual, built on proper hydration.
howToUse: Adults – 1 bottle (50 ml) a day, taken directly or mixed with water or juice.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, away from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at no more than +25 °C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Hydrolyzed fish (cod, pollock, haddock) collagen, vitamin C (ascorbic acid), vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), spinach (Spinacia oleracea) leaf powder, biotin, excipients (water, erythritol, citric acid, apple juice concentrate, natural orange flavor, natural lemon flavor, pectin, natural apple flavor, blueberry juice concentrate, steviol glycosides).
